newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps may downgrade Whirlpool.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps may downgrade Whirlpool.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Thursday it placed the ratings of Whirlpool Corp on watch for a possible downgrade. Whirlpool's senior notes are rated Single A and its liquid yield option notes are rated Single A minus.
About $1.7 billion of consolidated outstanding debt securities are affected.
Whirlpool's commercial paper is currently rated D One.

Duff & Phelps also said it placed ratings for Whirlpool Financial Corp on watch for a possible downgrade. Whirlpool Financial's medium-term notes are rated Single A and its preferred stock is rated Single A Minus.
The rating action is due to the short-term fall in earnings and reflects the likelihood of continued weak credit protection measures for the rating, Duff & Phelps said.
It said final year-end results probably will not meet expectations given the weak performance of Whirlpool Europe.
